sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Yubi, the Swordfighter Puppet (No. 21) is an optional encounter in Mandate Encampment, found at Training Grounds, past the main gate. Beating it yields Baishan Stormswords.

sections.title: Where to Find the Yubi, the Swordfighter Puppet (No. 21)
sections.content:
Location: Training Grounds, past the main gate.

Appears in: Mandate Encampment.

sections.title: Weaknesses and Counters
sections.content:
There is no weakness table for this fight because there is no damage-type system to fill one in: nothing here resists, absorbs or is immune to anything, and a chart that says otherwise has been inferred from how the boss looks. Read the fight by attack colour instead - red must be dodged, blue must be deflected, purple means it has just parried you and a counter is already coming. The full explanation is on the combat system.

It is optional, which is why it can be left until the Sha-Chi pool and the Phantom Edge roster are deeper.

sections.title: How to Beat the Yubi, the Swordfighter Puppet (No. 21)
sections.content:
What works

  • Break his guard for the Baishan Stormswords; the Training Grounds route is past the main gate.

sections.title: Status
sections.content: No. 39 of 60 in the progression order, in Mandate Encampment. Before it: Chief Disciple of the Seven-Stars Formation. After it: Grief-Stricken Jin. The roster by region is on the boss list, and the fights that can be lost by leaving a region early are on the order page. Location and drops come from the shipped game; patch 1.0302256 is the most recent change to any boss behaviour and it touched only Hua.
